name: Castles of Mad King Ludwig

categories.label: Score track (rooms, bonuses, connections)
categories.hint: VP gained during play from rooms placed, connection bonuses and rescoring.

categories.label: Rooms of depleted stacks
categories.hint: Each room in your castle whose size matches an emptied tile stack = 2 VP (Hallways/Stairs count if their stack is empty).

categories.label: King's Favor 1 (rank)
categories.hint: Rank on the Favor's category: 1st 8, 2nd 4, 3rd 2, 4th 1. Need at least 1 qualifying item. Ties split the tied ranks' VP, rounded down.

categories.label: King's Favor 2 (rank)
categories.hint: Rank on the Favor's category: 1st 8, 2nd 4, 3rd 2, 4th 1. Need at least 1 qualifying item. Ties split the tied ranks' VP, rounded down.

categories.label: King's Favor 3 (rank)
categories.hint: Rank on the Favor's category: 1st 8, 2nd 4, 3rd 2, 4th 1. Need at least 1 qualifying item. Ties split the tied ranks' VP, rounded down.

categories.label: Bonus cards
categories.hint: Sum of VP from your revealed Bonus cards.

categories.label: Leftover money (marks)
categories.hint: Enter total marks (e.g. 29000); 1 VP per full 10000.

categories.label: Castle area (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Total square footage; used only to break ties.

tiebreakers.description: Then most money; then first tied player to take the Master Builder token.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Verified against the current (2nd edition/Collector's) rulebook, not the 2014 first-edition rulebook; end-game scoring is expected to be identical. 3 King's Favors in a standard game (Favor scoring conditions are printed on the face-up tiles). Order: depleted stacks, Favors, Bonus cards, money. Game ends after the round in which the last Room card is drawn. Solo mode scores the same without Favors.
